question: What vision corresponds to the full and unlimited goddess-consciousness?
premises: If consciousness is full and unlimited, all would be in her and she would be everywhere.
One who sees the divine everywhere sees all in the divine.
inference: Full goddess-consciousness entails a reciprocal vision in which all is in her and she is in all.
plain_english: All would be in her, and she would be everywhere. Whoever sees me everywhere and sees all in me has that vision.
